html:
This year’s Da Nang – Hoi An Hot Air Balloon Festival will take place in a vibrant atmosphere. Coming here on this occasion, visitors will be able to participate in hot air balloon performances flying in the sky and admire the beauty of the coastal city from above, which will bring a sense of excitement.

This is considered one of the exciting festivals that brings new experiences to the people and visitors, aiming to promote the image of Quang Nam tourism to international visitors and friends.

Traveling to Da Nang on the hot air balloon festival, visitors will be able to fly in the air as if inviting visitors to visit, bringing visitors an interesting vacation, admiring the beautiful landscapes of the Central region.

Taking a tour to Da Nang on the hot air balloon festival, visitors will be able to check in and take pictures next to colorful hot air balloons, spread out at the APEC Sculpture Garden Park on Bach Dang Street, visitors will be able to fly with a guide at a height of 15 m to 40 m to admire the scenery of Da Nang from above.

The hot air balloon performance from 7pm to 8pm with fire dragon performances, blowing up the bridge, building the bridge, including 12 mini hot air balloons, 3 level 7 hot air balloons and 2 inflatable hot air balloons serving visitors 24/7.

It can be said that this year’s hot air balloon festival will bring visitors unique experiences, especially for visitors to Da Nang during the festival. In Hoi An, the hot air balloon festival is also bustling, with many events that will bring people and visitors unique experiences.

During the festival, colorful hot air balloons will be displayed flying in the sky of Quang Nam, with 12 mini hot air balloons, 3 level 7 hot air balloons and 2 inflatable hot air balloons arranged to fly over the Hoai River, bringing visitors brilliant colors.

Especially at 7pm – 8pm on March 25, there will be a lantern night program with the blowing of fire into the balloon cages, at this time the balloons shine like sparkling lanterns, visitors can also participate in the game of shaking the basket on the Hoai River, creating a vibrant atmosphere.

It can be said that the Da Nang Hoi An hot air balloon festival promises to bring the most interesting experiences to the people and visitors, especially when flying in the air, admiring the scenery of Quang Nam from above.
